findings.event: Rebooting State Capacity hackathon (London, 26-27 Apr 2025; newsletter post dated 5 May 2025)
findings.winner_or_demo: 1st Treasury Busters (£1,000); 2nd DVSA Reimagined (£500); 3rd A1 Voice (£250). Basis Prize 'Outcompeting the Government' (£1,000): A1 Voice. Honourable mentions: SCYLLA, Hacknee, Fighting Crime One Query at a Time, Pranav, Seaguard.
findings.what_they_built: Treasury Busters: a dynamic single source of truth to build and approve or reject business cases for major spending projects. DVSA Reimagined: streamlined first government interaction for young people (getting a driving licence). A1 Voice: smart voicemail for NHS hospitals handling over 10,000 daily calls to clinical departments; the post says it engaged 17 departments across 6 NHS trusts (Basis Prize). SCYLLA: backscatter seabed sensing for undersea infrastructure. Hacknee: prediction markets for local council decisions. Fighting Crime One Query at a Time: automated analysis and reporting to make crime data more accessible. Pranav: visual odometry for GPS-denied mapping. Seaguard: small-vessel maritime detection with computer vision. Partners thanked: 10 Downing Street, i.AI, Basis, Delian Alliance Industries, Palantir, ElevenLabs, PUBLIC. No team members or judges named. CORRECTIONS to the first pass: year 2025 is confirmed by the post date, and the A1 Voice '10,000 daily calls' figure was missing.
